limitations: Requested URL redirects to login; private verification/setup/game screens were not inspected.
Playwright library used with explicit user authorization instead of Playwright MCP.
Homepage promotional overlay dismissed with its visible close button.
DOM sectionGaps and grid are empty; screenshot and targeted box measurements supply layout evidence.
Source colors are documentary only and must not be adopted.

taste.name: Curved sections set the pace
taste.trigger: Moving between introduction and detailed game information
taste.decision: Use broad curved color boundaries instead of enclosing every section in a card
taste.reason: The reader can recognize a new topic before reading its heading

taste.name: Buttons feel pressable
taste.trigger: Giving a short call to action visual priority
taste.decision: Use 48–56px pills with inset lower shading instead of a flat text link
taste.reason: The action has a distinct physical silhouette among the illustrations

taste.name: Portrait images carry the game choice
taste.decision: Pair portrait artwork with short copy instead of long feature inventories
taste.reason: Pictures establish the subject quickly while copy explains the next action

taste.name: One Arabic family is enough
taste.trigger: Distinguishing navigation, display copy and explanations
taste.decision: Use one Arabic family with size and weight changes instead of mixing display families
taste.reason: Arabic letter rhythm stays consistent across the long page
